items.title: Open enforcement question: DeFi enforcement
items.detail: Does Backed actually publish the amount of Lent Underlyings 'on a regular basis on their website' as the prospectus promises? Not found on the product pages or the PoR dashboard — and whether lending is enabled per-Product is set in each product's Final Terms, which could not be downloaded (the product page's document links are unpopulated placeholders).
items.action: Obtain protocol or issuer evidence for enforceable custody, liquidation and exit after default.

items.title: Open enforcement question: DeFi enforcement
items.detail: Is SECZ actually live as DeFi collateral? Press of 2026-08-20 reports SECZ linked to Solana on-chain credit markets. Unverified by rwa-sonar. If true it would need an oracle feed (none located) and would raise the same jurisdiction-of-use question the Superstate/Kamino integration raises.
items.action: Obtain protocol or issuer evidence for enforceable custody, liquidation and exit after default.

items.title: Open enforcement question: DeFi enforcement
items.detail: Which mint does each Series Operating Agreement actually govern? Every agreement locates the token in "the Smart Contract located at an address and a blockchain to be determined", and the Series 17 (S&P 500) agreement requires "at least one (1) TSLA Short SHFT Token". Nothing published links the mints that trade to the Series that hold the assets.
items.action: Obtain protocol or issuer evidence for enforceable custody, liquidation and exit after default.

items.title: Open enforcement question: DeFi enforcement
items.detail: Does the Chainlink Proof-of-Reserves integration exist at all? The docs describe it as gating every mint and publishing every block; the dashboard link is "[TO BE UPDATED]", no feed naming SHIFT was found, and no observed mint transaction touches an oracle account.
items.action: Obtain protocol or issuer evidence for enforceable custody, liquidation and exit after default.
